sentences.en: After playing golf, we enjoy drinks in the new clubhouse.
sentences.zh: 打完高尔夫后，我们喜欢在新俱乐部屋里喝饮料。

sentences.en: Hats aren't allowed to be worn inside the clubhouse.
sentences.zh: 帽子不允许戴进俱乐部屋里。

sentences.en: Tuesday we will go to the clubhouse.
sentences.zh: 星期二我们要去俱乐部屋。

senses.zh: 俱乐部会所，俱乐部,运动员更衣室
